Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("Listing Regulations"), this to inform that the company has opted to settle the pending appeals before Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals)-31, New Delhi for the Assessment Year 2007-08 and 2011-12 under Direct Tax Vivad Se Vishwas Scheme, 2024. Principal Commissioners of Income Tax, Indore ("PR CIT") has accepted the request of the company to settle the dispute pertaining to both the assessment years vide separate orders dated 5th May, 2025 which is received to company on dated 7th May, 2025. Further, the said appeals filed by the Company for Assessment Year 2007-08 and 2011-12 were considered material and intimated to the stock exchanges by the Company on 11th August, 2023 and as well as through Integrated Corporate Governance Report for Q3 FY25 and Q4FY25, submitted to stock exchanges.
